title: Flake checks that evaluate every host
body: Add `checks` to nix/flake.nix: per host, a derivation that forces config.system.build.toplevel.drvPath (and each homeConfigurations activationPackage) without building it, so `nix flake check` catches a broken module, option or assertion on any machine. Darwin hosts under aarch64-darwin. Register it as a test on the root (run from WSL on vghydra: `nix flake check ./nix`), which reaches every part; CI follows (baseline rule nix.flake-check). vgsquid-* and vgnixmini only evaluate once their hardware-configuration.nix exists. This session verified each commit by hand with exactly these evaluations.

title: Generate and commit hardware-configuration.nix for vgsquid-azul
body: Run nixos-generate-config on the machine and commit nix/nixos/vgsquid-azul/hardware-configuration.nix (flakes only see tracked files).

title: Generate and commit hardware-configuration.nix for vgsquid-onyx
body: Run nixos-generate-config on the machine and commit nix/nixos/vgsquid-onyx/hardware-configuration.nix.

title: Generate and commit hardware-configuration.nix for vgnixmini
body: vgnixmini/default.nix imports ./hardware-configuration.nix, which isn't in the repo, so the host doesn't evaluate.

title: First Hyprland session on vgkraken's 7800 XT
body: Log in to Hyprland (uwsm) once on the real hardware: pin monitors in hypr.d/hyprland.conf (hyprctl monitors all), check the GPU it renders on (AQ_DRM_DEVICES note in uwsm.d/env-hyprland), the lock screen, keyring unlock, Qt/GTK theming and udiskie. Then decide whether Plasma stays (see the decision on vgkraken).
